verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says action items are generated automatically after every meeting, and AskFred can be asked "What are my action items from this week's meetings?", which implies items are attributed to people and can be retrieved across meetings. Nothing documents explicit owner assignment or a dedicated place to collect and track action items, such as a task list or task-manager sync. Missing for 10: documented owner attribution per action item, a central action-item tracker or task-tool integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
